name: Kızılcahamam–Çerkeş Tunnel
facts: Kızılcahamam–Çerkeş Tunnel, stretching 2,071 meters, opened to traffic on 27 February 2021, dramatically cutting travel time from 15 minutes to just 3 minutes across Central Anatolia.
By cutting the route length by about 2.4 kilometers, the tunnel eases harsh winter driving on high-elevated, sloping terrain, making journeys safer and more comfortable for commuters.
Constructed between Ankara Province's Kızılcahamam and Çankırı Province's Çerkeş, the tunnel exemplifies modern Turkish infrastructure aimed at improving regional connectivity.
